summary.en: Admitted sends and receive claims have independent stable identities and never wrap their epochs or sequences.
summary.zh-CN: 接纳消息与接收快照分别维护身份，代次及序号不回绕。

title.zh-CN: 隔离且持久的消息缓冲状态

summary.en: Message state belongs to explicit context banks outside trap snapshots, with disabled legacy behavior preserved.
summary.zh-CN: 消息状态按上下文分组，位于陷阱快照之外，未启用时保持旧行为。

summary.en: Current kernel contexts access their own message registers while privileged configuration and precise rejection protect isolation.
summary.zh-CN: 当前 kernel 访问自己的消息寄存器，特权配置和精确拒绝保证隔离。

summary.en: Acknowledgement validates a fully read exact token and retains independent replay state without consuming a later claim.
summary.zh-CN: 确认检查完整读取及精确 token，独立保留重放状态，不消费后续快照。

summary.en: Enabled BSE validates control and endpoint state before atomically capturing payload and allocating a transport identity.
summary.zh-CN: 启用后的 BSE 先检查控制字与端点，再原子捕获载荷并分配传输身份。

title.zh-CN: 消息调用生命周期排空边界

summary.en: Lifecycle drain closes new admission while preserving receive progress and committed identities until quiescence.
summary.zh-CN: 生命周期排空关闭新接纳，同时保留接收进展及已提交身份直到静止。

title.zh-CN: 消息寄存器字段与地址

summary.en: The assigned register family defines split staging and snapshot access, precise ACK fields, and privileged context configuration.
summary.zh-CN: 新分配寄存器族定义暂存与快照的分离访问、精确 ACK 字段及特权上下文配置。
